clause: Prototype domain binding: studio.prototype command family + StudioPrototypeFlow + engine boundary [STU-PRO-001,STU-ARC-002]

scope.summary: Wire the handshake_core::studio::prototype domain: register the studio.prototype.<command>.v<N> command family over the MT-007 command surface, bind StudioPrototypeFlow (hsk.studio.prototype_flow@1) as the single prototyping primitive owning the document's interaction graph (hotspot -> trigger -> action bindings between StudioLayer nodes, named flow starting points, per-flow settings), and route every mutation through STUDIO_* EventLedger events (MT-003) + studio_* Postgres authority (MT-004). It replaces every source-suite prototyping surface with one primitive and one command family.
acceptance_criteria: studio.prototype command family routes through ledger + Postgres; StudioPrototypeFlow bound as single primitive
expected_tests: live: studio.prototype command mutation emits ledger event + lands in studio_* authority via PromotionGate
test: StudioPrototypeFlow is the single interaction-graph primitive; no source-suite prototyping fork

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No prototype domain wiring; all 14.11 prototyping MTs unroutable and unauditable.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
